chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Usman ibn Isa, from Is'haq ibn Jarir, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'A devil called Al-Qafandar, whenever in the house of a man a flute is played for forty days, and men come over for it, that devil places every part of his upon a similar part of the owner of the house, then blows into him with a blowing, so he does not care after that until they (the other men) come on to his wives, so he does not care'.

key_terms.الْبَرْبَطِ: A musical instrument, specifically a lute or flute
key_terms.الْقَفَنْدَرُ: A specific name of a devil mentioned in the hadith
key_terms.يَغَارُ: To be jealous or protective of one's honor

ai.seo_question: What is the effect of prolonged music on a person's spiritual state according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) linking the prolonged performance of music, specifically on the barbat (lute), to the spiritual weakening of a man's 'ghirah' (protective jealousy). The devil Al-Qafandar imprints upon the host, causing him to become indifferent to his wives' modesty as long as men are present, illustrating how musical gatherings can erode domestic honor and social boundaries.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Usman Bin Isa, from Is’haq Bin Jareyr who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘A devil called Al-Qafandar, whenever in the house of a man a flute is played for forty days, and men come over for it, that devil places every part of his upon a similar part of the owner of the house, then blows into him with a blowing, so he does not care after that until they (the other men) come on to his wives, so he does not care’.
en.sarwar: 14. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Ishaq ibn Jarir who has said the following: “I once heard abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘

There is Satan called al-Qafandar. If barbat (a musical instrument) is played in a house for forty days and men come to him then that Satan places every part of his (Satan’s) body on every part of the body of the owner of the house, then blows a blow; and thereafter he will not mind even if people go in on to his women.’”
